thought.text: Now the key test: a single `just serve` for all three with heap caps to keep them within memory:

reasoning_content: All stopped, 1.3GB free. Now the decisive test: start a single `just serve` (all 3) with NODE_OPTIONS heap cap, so each build stays small and all 3 can coexist.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/capserve.log
setsid nohup env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=900" bash -c 'exec just serve < /dev/zero' > /tmp/capserve.log 2>&1 &
echo "serve pid $!"
for i in $(seq 1 11); do
  up=0; states=""
  for p in 39001 39002 39003; do
    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$code" = "200" ] && up=$((up+1))
  done
  echo "check $i: $up/3 up  avail=$(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $6}')MB"
  [ $up -eq 3 ] && break
  sleep 45
done
